title: Combined study and practical stays for engineers from developing countries (KOSPIE) with Colombian universities • DAAD
summary: Funding for advanced engineering students from specific Colombian universities to spend a study semester and an industrial internship in Germany.

values: Escuela Colombiana de Ingeniería Julio Garavito, Bogotá
institutions.notes: Must be from one of the listed participating Colombian universities.

residence.notes: Country in which you are living and from which you are applying must be Colombia.

mandatory.text: Advanced students of engineering from one of the listed participating universities
Knowledge of German (at least Level B1)

funding.description: Preparatory German language courses in Colombia (university); Costs of outward and return travel (ICETEX); 2-month intensive language course in Germany including costs of accommodation and pocket money of 475 euros a month during this period (DAAD); One-off study allowance of 460 euros (DAAD); Medical, accident and personal liability insurance (DAAD); Monthly partial scholarship of 342 euros for 10 months (DAAD); Monthly partial scholarship of 650 euros for 10 months (ICETEX); Tutorial supervision at German host university (DAAD)

steps.text: Students from the above schools apply through the International Office.

sources.title: Combined study and practical stays for engineers from developing countries (KOSPIE) with Colombian universities - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Supports international students from Colombia for study and practical stays physically in Germany.
